supporting_observations.claim: The large outbound transfer is strongly consistent with the approved backup activity: Vaultline's installed agent ran as svc-bkp with a Nightly job targeting ingest.vaultline-backup.com, and the proxy recorded about 640 MB client-to-server.

Shortly before the agent ran, the domain controller recorded a service ticket for svc-bkp from public IP 45.79.19.196; a svc-bkp service logon on FILE-PIN-01 followed. This timing and account link warrant verification, but do not establish that the external request caused or controlled the transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy and connection records provide destination, byte counts, and timing, but do not show the uploaded files or their contents; the large transfer is represented by T090-00328 and T090-00331.
The supplied records do not establish who controlled source IP 45.79.19.196 or whether the svc-bkp ticket request was authorized; the request is recorded in T090-00310.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-bkp service-ticket request from 45.79.19.196 was legitimate or reflected credential misuse.
Whether the data uploaded in the Vaultline transfer was an expected backup dataset.
Whether the backup agent's execution and upload were initiated by the expected scheduled job rather than influenced by unauthorized activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Validate the svc-bkp ticket request with domain-controller authentication details and network/firewall records for 45.79.19.196.
Review FILE-PIN-01 service configuration and change history, and Vaultline job logs or manifests for the run and uploaded data.
Confirm with the backup service owner whether this job, destination, timing, and volume were expected.
unrelated_findings: Separate ticket: emma.stone launched RDP from WS-ESTONE-01 to FILE-PIN-01, and an interactive RDP logon was recorded on the file server; the inventory says remote administration is only performed from WS-RPATEL-01. This does not determine the alerted transfer. (T090-00041, T090-00047, T090-00055)

Separate ticket: FILE-PIN-01 made a proxy connection to receiver.citrix.com using python-requests; Citrix is not listed among approved services. This does not determine the alerted transfer. (T090-00090, T090-00091)
